name: Fennel (Florence)

schedule.notes: Doesn't transplant well — taproot. Or start in deep peat pots.
To 12 in. Hill soil around the base as bulbs form.
Fall is the better season — heat triggers bolting.
Cut bulb at the soil line when fist-sized. Fronds keep regrowing.

harvest.cues: Bulb is firm, fist-sized to softball-sized. Cut at the base. Fronds and seed are also edible.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge in plastic 1 week. Slice and freeze cooked into stocks; raw fronds don't store well.

varieties.name: Zefa Fino
varieties.notes: Bred for slow bolting. Best for spring sowings.

varieties.name: Perfection
varieties.notes: Large, white bulbs. Best in fall — bolts fast in heat.

notes: Allelopathic — inhibits the growth of most other crops. Plant in its own corner away from tomatoes, beans, cilantro, dill. Bolt-prone above 75 F or with any stress.
